Each requirement is backed by a direct quoted snippet from the provided passages.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Airbnb generates revenue from service fees and host fees related to stays and experiences.","passage_rank":5,"quote":"Revenue Our revenue consists of service fees, net of incentives and refunds, charged to our customers."},{"requirement":"For stays, service fees are a percentage of the booking value (excluding taxes); for experiences, a host fee is earned.","passage_rank":5,"quote":"For stays, service fees, which are charged to customers as a percentage of the value of the booking, excluding taxes, vary based on factors specific to the booking, such as duration, geography, and host type."},{"requirement":"For experiences, we only earn a host fee.","passage_rank":5,"quote":"For experiences, we only earn a host fee."},{"requirement":"Substantially all revenue comes from stays.","passage_rank":5,"quote":"Substantially all of our revenue comes from stays booked on our platform."},{"requirement":"Revenue is recognized upon check-in; pre-check-in amounts are recorded as unearned fees.","passage_rank":5,"quote":"We experience a difference in timing between when a booking is made and when we recognize revenue, which occurs upon check-in.
